title: THE INSPECTOR WHO FAILED EVERY BRIDGE
author: GPT

rounds.summary: Hardest external conflict of the ten that stays entirely human and checkable: a corrupt inspector who is also a frightened protector, armed owners, a clinic with twelve hours of oxygen, and a counterpart whose objection (a true report is paper, their rifles are steel) is a real political position, not a strawman. The decisive idea, turning a suppressible accusation into a test thousands can repeat before the armed lie arrives, is surprising beforehand and clear afterwards, and it is shown through observation (vibration signatures) rather than exposition. Many parties keep a real veto (miners, drivers, patients, bridge crews, Dar). The positive result is concrete: oxygen delivered, sound bridges reopened under worker control, an independent laboratory, Dar accepting trial by his own choice.

A strong, physically specific S1 draft: the acoustic-emission triage, the blind sealed-tab test run by Jori, and a counterpart (Rusk) with a coherent political case give it real opposition and agency to the other parties. The positive outcome is concrete (oxygen to the clinic with 73 minutes to spare, three spans reopened under posted limits, an independent laboratory, Dar accepting trial). The main work for the next revision is that the decisive turn of the armed counterpart currently depends on catastrophe and a physical catch, and the oxygen clock is weakened by the unexplained question of why she does not simply carry it.

T03 is a clear step forward. The wage bond, the rail minimum and Dar's south-pin confession now reach Rusk before the scout moves, and the 13:49 suspension is an answer to his stated aim, so the turn at the table is earned by understanding. Els is distinct from Lina, and the public-custody scene gives Dar a bounded future. Three things remain. The scout crossing that follows works against the turn the story has just earned, so the collapse is decorative and a rescue by power. The reason Illuminara does not simply carry the ten line-feed cylinders is still not stated in one checkable sentence. The last third repeats tallies and ends with an administrative inventory. All three can be fixed without losing the blind test, the wage-bond clause, 'The rifles were still steel', the front-handle moment or the clean narrowing note at the end.

All three ranked T04 points are resolved in T05. Rusk now chooses a crew-owned, unmanned, rope-hauled proof run after his own suspension, so Illuminara meets his remaining need instead of rescuing him; the physical catch shrinks to bracing a parapet and no person is endangered. The oxygen constraint is a visible four-point support problem that Mara demonstrates with the pendulum stops and the four-degree mark, so the human carrying chain is necessary and checkable. The last two scenes drop the repeated tallies and move from consequence to the clean narrowing note.

final_critic_line: A bought inspector's fear is answered not by force or rescue but by a proof the crews own: the babies breathe, three bridges reopen, and he stays accountable.
